Asia Pacific Institute of Hotel Management vs International Institute of Hotel Management is a same-city hotel-management comparison. You will need official fee notices from both institutes before you can budget.

sections.heading: Asia Pacific Institute of Hotel Management vs International Institute of Hotel Management for BHM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a fee winner, because neither institute has a BHM fee row in our records.
IIHM has the only placement row here, from 2014, with an average of ₹2 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh. That year is older than 2020, so we do not treat it as a current flagship result.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: We do not hold a quotable BHM fee for Asia Pacific Institute of Hotel Management on this page. Ask the institute for its current official fee circular, including hostel and training charges if they are billed separately.
We also do not hold a BHM fee for the International Institute of Hotel Management in Ahmedabad. Do not guess the fee from another IIHM campus. Use the official Ahmedabad notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Asia Pacific Institute of Hotel Management has no placement row on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report.
IIHM's latest recorded year here is 2014. Because that is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current outcome. Ask IIHM Ahmedabad for a recent official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Hotel-management admissions may use Class 12 marks, an institute test, or a national exam such as NCHM JEE, depending on the campus.
Read the current official admissions page of each Ahmedabad institute for the test that actually applies.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both institutes are listed in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Confirm the teaching campus and any training hotel or kitchen location before you join.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the official fee and training arrangements will decide more than the city name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On this page, the honest verdict is that the data is too thin for a fee or salary winner.
Get both official fee circulars and the latest official placement reports before you choose.
Do not use the 2014 IIHM row as a forecast for a 2026 graduating class.
